description:
Record a compliance evidence event in the Mima governance ledger, mapped to EU AI Act, SOC 2 Type II, ISO 42001, and NIST AI RMF controls. 

Call this when the AI system performs a governance-relevant action that requires an audit trail: a human reviewing or overriding an AI decision, a risk assessment being completed, a model being evaluated for accuracy or bias, an access review, a policy being acknowledged, or an incident being reported. 

Do NOT call this for routine AI inference calls — only for actions where a regulator or auditor would expect documented evidence. 

Returns the record_id and the list of compliance controls earned (e.g. EUAIA_ART14, SOC2_CC6.1). The GRC manager sees these in the Mima governance dashboard and they count toward the readiness score.

enforce_gates.description: If true, checks all required governance gates before writing. Recommended for production actions and high-risk systems. If a required gate is failing, the write is blocked — use dry_run_attest to confirm this record would earn controls that close the gap, then re-call attest without enforce_gates once you have verified the impact.

environment.description: Deployment environment. Defaults to 'production' on the server side.

identity.description: User or service identity performing the action. E.g. 'user@example.com'.

occurred_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the event occurred. Defaults to now.

payload.description: Event-specific fields. Unknown fields are stored but do not earn additional controls. For human_oversight: { decision, reviewer, outcome_summary, system_prompt_version? }. For ai_risk_assessment: { risk_level, risk_summary, art5_self_assessment?, mitigations? }. For model_evaluation: { accuracy, robustness_score?, bias_metrics?, evaluated_by? }. For incident_report: { severity, description, resolution? }.

record_type.description: The governance event type. Maps to the SDK's 11 record types.

resource.description: The resource or entity acted upon. E.g. 'customer-id:12345'.

system_name.description: Name of the AI system generating this record. E.g. 'loan-scoring-v2'. Alphanumeric, spaces, hyphens, underscores, and dots only.

name: attest
